tools.name: check_deliverability
tools.description: Grade a domain A-F for cold email readiness. Checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, blacklists and domain age together and returns a weighted score with a per-check breakdown and what to fix. Start here for open-ended "is this domain any good" questions.

tools.name: check_spf
tools.description: Look up a domain's SPF record and validate it, including the recursive DNS lookup count that silently breaks SPF past 10.

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.description: Find and validate a domain's DKIM signing key, including key strength. Leave selector empty to auto-scan 26 common selectors (google, selector1, k1, and the rest). tools.name: check_bimi
tools.description: Validate a domain's BIMI record, the logo SVG, the VMC, and the DMARC enforcement level Gmail requires before it will show a brand logo.

tools.name: check_mta_sts
tools.description: Validate a domain's _mta-sts DNS record and its published policy file: mode, MX patterns, max_age and TLS-RPT.

tools.name: check_ssl
tools.description: Read a host's TLS certificate: issuer, validity dates and days remaining, subject alternative names, key type and size, signature algorithm, chain, negotiated protocol and whether the chain is trusted and covers the hostname. tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: Query any DNS record type for a domain: MX, TXT, A, AAAA, CNAME, NS, SOA, CAA.

tools.name: lookup_txt

tools.name: check_rdns
tools.description: The PTR record for an IPv4 or IPv6 address, and the forward lookup that decides whether it counts. tools.name: check_blacklist
tools.description: Check a domain or IP against 20+ major email blacklists (Spamhaus, Barracuda, SORBS and others) and report which list it appears on.

tools.name: check_surbl
tools.description: Check domains against the SURBL URI blacklist in bulk. URI blacklists list the domains that appear inside a message body, so a listed tracking or landing domain sends the whole email to spam however clean the sender is. Up to 100 domains per call.

tools.name: check_nameservers
tools.description: Get the NS records and the DNS provider behind one domain or a whole list. Useful for working out who actually controls a domain's DNS before trying to fix its records.

tools.name: check_domain_expiry
tools.description: Get a domain's registrar, creation date, expiry date and days remaining, over RDAP with a WHOIS fallback for ccTLDs that publish no RDAP service. Domain age is one of the strongest cold-email risk signals.

tools.name: check_google_domain
tools.description: Tell whether a domain is already attached to a Google Workspace account, or is clear for a fresh Google tenant.

tools.name: check_cname
tools.description: Follow a host's full CNAME chain and flag the mistakes that break a cold-email tracking domain. Pass expected to assert where the chain should end up.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Check email addresses for syntax, live MX records, disposable providers and role prefixes (info@, sales@). Does not open SMTP connections, so catch-all domains come back valid.

tools.name: lookup_mx
tools.description: Look up a domain's MX records with priorities and resolved IPs, and identify the mailbox provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho, Fastmail and others) and any security gateway in front of it (Mimecast, Proofpoint, Barracuda and others). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_dmarc" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
